g.text: Lower posterior expected cost produced more actual membership calls

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: PRIMARY FALSIFIED: 2,913 actual continuation calls; required ≤2,588 for a 5% reduction.

text.style: font-size: 11.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Same archived eight-positive banks and unchanged four-query checkpoints; 1,354/1,408 exact cases preserved.

text.style: font-size: 11.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: All 439 feasible sets compiled before any new labels; the 54 infeasible cases and 287 prior successes are retained.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: The expected objective improved 17.16%; it did not predict a realized cost benefit on these selected truths.

text.style: font-size: 11.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: 5,577 inherited MAP calls + 2,913 newly charged calls = 8,490 policy calls, versus 8,302 originally.

text.style: font-size: 11.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: 2,020 new queries reacquire archived same-case answers; 893 query boards were absent from that parent case.

g.text: Archived-source intervention, not independent confirmation. No new failures is a correctness invariant.

g.text: Exact expected-cost optimization remains valid under its specified source posterior; population calibration is untested.
